title: America: Hammer of the Earth
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-02-22

Opens [Acts 7](/bible/acts/7) · [Eph 6](/bible/ephesians/6) · [Isa 47](/bible/isaiah/47) · [Jer 2](/bible/jeremiah/2) · [Jer 50](/bible/jeremiah/50) · [Isa 21](/bible/isaiah/21) · [Ps 41](/bible/psalms/41) · [Isa 59](/bible/isaiah/59)
## Introduction *[[17:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=1042s)]* America, the hammer of the whole earth. Back in New York, Bishop Nathanyel first proves this truth cannot be stopped: the church in the wilderness is Israel, of the increase of Christ's government there shall be no end, the kingdom of Daniel 2:44 shall never be destroyed, and the gates of hell, the pyramid of spiritual wickedness in high places from the crown council of thirteen down to the labor units at the bottom, shall not prevail. Then Isaiah 47, Jeremiah 2 and 50, and Isaiah 21 lay out Babylon's fall: the well-favoured harlot whose allies deceive her, the shepherds who caused the people to go astray, the nations from the north, the least of the flock drawing Babylon out, the watchman crying Babylon is fallen, Elam and Media rising, and the Arab defense pact of Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan fulfilling 2 Esdras 15. Christ alone will not meet her as a man, and he will requite the traitors. ## In The News - *[[18:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=1094s)]* **The class thumbnail animation: is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms? The hammer of the earth. In one hour is thy judgment come; the queen becomes ash.** — Fire. Guests in the building from DC, Detroit, Tupelo, Rochester, Austin, and Jacksonville, where a raccoon walked toward the bishop and Captain Enoch at Tabernacles. - *[[32:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=1927s)]* **A pyramid of the world's power structure: Satan and the fallen angels, the Rothschilds and Rockefellers and thirteen super-rich families, secret societies, world leaders, the Vatican and policy makers, religious leaders and politicians, Hollywood and the music industry, law enforcement and the IRS, and the common population at the bottom.** — That is the gates of hell of Matthew 16:18 and the spiritual wickedness in high places of Ephesians 6:12. To overthrow the system you would have to go through all of that, and only God can. - *[[33:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=1992s)]* **The colorful chart: the all-seeing eye of Ra from the dollar bill, the crown council of 13, the committee of 300, the think tanks, the world financial control of the IMF, World Bank, and central banks, world resource control, religion, government, media, and the population as labor units and debt slaves: you are here.** — When Trump threatened Canada, the man who runs the electrical grid from Canada down the Northeast said he would shut the power off, and Trump backed up. They work together, and the elite hand the media the message for us. - *[[50:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=3005s)]* **The street layout of Washington, D.C., forming a pentagram.** — Stand now with thine enchantments and the multitude of thy sorceries wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth: 1776. Not a God-fearing country but witchcraft, and the Epstein letters about killing babies have some truth. - *[[54:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=3272s)]* **Pastor Pam saying nothing that goes in you defiles you, bless your food and eat the pork, and a Christian teacher answering that Jesus never called the pig clean and no writer from Genesis to Revelation eats anything unclean.** — The prophets prophesy by Baal, Jeremiah 2:8. - *[[55:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=3326s)]* **A commentator on why black men left the black church: name one major thing it has done for the community in sixty years; we are in on the hustle; no man worth his salt will let you elevate a pastor to God status over him; churches full of 300-pounders working out only for a thirst trap; not one school board or governor fears the black church; you have become modern-day Pharisees.** — Sixty years is 1965 to 2025, and now it is going back to before 1965. In Christianity women put the pastor above their husbands, and sisters here have tried to use us as a whipping stick against their husbands; sit down. The churches breed weak beta males who need to get their manhood back from their wife's pocketbook. - *[[1:03:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=3831s)]* **A black church congregation doing a lewd dance during service.** — Total foolishness. That is why black women fill the churches. - *[[1:05:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=3915s)]* **A commentary on the textbook African Americans: A Concise History: congregations did not want scholarly sermons; Booker T. Washington said three-fourths of Baptist ministers and two-thirds of Methodists were unfit mentally or morally to preach; Du Bois wanted the noisy and unclean leaders replaced; black clergymen refused to challenge white supremacy and blamed black people's shameful situations on their sinful ways.** — It is right there in the book. Today's pastors went to divinity school and adopted Roman Catholic ways because of that criticism, and they still refuse to challenge white supremacy. - *[[1:12:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=4339s)]* **Pastor Mike Todd on gay men: I wish there was an option of other in the kingdom; I do not know.** — Their shepherds have caused them to go astray, Jeremiah 50:6. - *[[1:13:44](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=4424s)]* **Black men in red dresses at an annual church charity event, and a brother answering that a man has no business in a skirt; just give the money.** — Every time a black man is in the spotlight they slide in something to demasculate him and take away the aggression God gave him to protect and lead. - *[[1:15:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=4537s)]* **A woman gushing that the pastor of the Powerhouse Church of Miami introduced his partner as the first gentleman, then footage of the church.** — Black women who support homosexuality raise the effeminate boys and then say they cannot find a good man. These are the shepherds of our people. - *[[1:17:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=4666s)]* **News reports: a North Tulsa pastor sentenced to fifteen years for raping his own daughter, whose Christianity tells her to forgive him and give him another chance; a Clarksville senior pastor arrested on eight counts of rape of girls thirteen and fifteen; two Baltimore pastors charged with a murder-for-hire of a blind, mentally disabled man for a million dollars in insurance.** — Never trust a fat black pastor: a Christian who cannot discipline his lust or his food. This is how the shepherds have caused them to go astray. - *[[1:25:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=5110s)]* **A prosperity preacher declaring a year of overflow, and a Reformed pastor saying ninety to ninety-five percent of the black church is heretical, that black men lack the theology to pastor, and that the black church should be split up and sent to good God-fearing white churches.** — We agree with everything he said; it is what Du Bois and Booker T. said. But the remedy is not the white church. - *[[1:40:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=6016s)]* **A report on Operation Midnight Hammer: seven B-2 bombers, 125 warplanes, 75 precision weapons, fourteen bunker-busting MOPs dropped on Natanz and Fordow in 25 minutes, with satellite images suggesting Iran moved its enriched uranium and equipment first.** — They named it the Midnight Hammer because their scholars know exactly who they are: the hammer of the whole earth, Jeremiah 50:23. It is the church down here that is clueless. - *[[1:51:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=6695s)]* **A map of American military bases around the world.** — When the country is destroyed, like Olympus Has Fallen, the military is still in full effect from its bases. That is why no chosen man can be appointed over her, and the Lord himself must step in. - *[[1:55:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=6933s)]* **The Guardian: Israel's bombing of Qatar threatens the fabric of Gulf security; Gulf states no longer believe a close US relationship guarantees their safety, after Israel tried to kill the Hamas negotiators in Doha the day after accepting the ceasefire proposal.** — Saddam told the Arabs that once they finished with him they would come for the rest. Bombing peace talks is how the least of the flock draws Babylon out. - *[[1:58:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=7122s)]* **An Israeli official: Turkey is the new Iran; Erdogan seeks to encircle Israel, Turkey and Qatar nourish the Islamic Brotherhood, and Turkey is trying to flip Saudi Arabia and establish a hostile Sunni axis with nuclear Pakistan.** — Turkey is north of Israel. Countries from the north are coming down against these people. - *[[2:22:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=8542s)]* **A report on the Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey defense pact: an article-five style alliance with 1.2 million personnel, over a thousand fighter jets, six thousand tanks, 350 naval units, and Pakistan's nuclear weapons, which all Muslim countries may eventually join.** — Turkey is a NATO member, but Erdogan wants a NATO for the Arab nations because he hates the Israelis. That is 2 Esdras 15:28-31 unfolding. - *[[2:29:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=8952s)]* **Qatar calling an emergency Arab Islamic summit of 57 Muslim countries after the strike on Doha, with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman giving Qatar permission for revenge and options including an oil embargo and cutting ties with Israel.** — The dragons conspiring together, remembering their nature. I like it when Bible prophecy unfolds before our eyes. - *[[2:38:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=9512s)]* **The definition of requite: to make appropriate return for a favor, service, or wrongdoing.** — Raise me up, that I may requite them, Psalms 41:10. Christ rises on the third day for vengeance. ## Scriptures Opened **[Acts 7:37-38](/bible/acts/7#v37)** *[[21:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=1267s)]* > [37](/bible/acts/7#v37) This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear. > > [38](/bible/acts/7#v38) This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us: - A prophet shall the Lord raise up of your brethren like unto me; this is he that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel in mount Sinai and with our fathers, who received the lively oracles, the law that gives life. The church in the wilderness is Israel, and there is no Baptist, Pentecostal, Roman Catholic, Jehovah's Witness, or Seventh-day church in the Bible; the only church is the twelve tribes. - Be preemptive with the Christians who run to Exodus 12:38, the mixed multitude, to say other nations were part of the church. Leviticus 25:45-46: of the children of the strangers that sojourn among you shall ye buy, and they shall be your bondmen for ever. The mixed multitude were our slaves. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 9:6-7](/bible/isaiah/9#v6)** > [6](/bible/isaiah/9#v6) For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace. > > [7](/bible/isaiah/9#v7) Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this. Unto us a child is born, and the government shall be upon his shoulder; the church of Acts 7 is the government of Christ. He is called the everlasting Father because much of the Old Testament's Father is Christ; have I been so long time with you, Philip, and hast thou not known me? Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end: it starts as a mustard seed and grows, and once started there is no stopping it. - **[Daniel 2:44](/bible/daniel/2#v44)** > [44](/bible/daniel/2#v44) And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever. In the days of these kings, the ten toes of iron and clay, America, shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed. Israelites are waking up all over the world now. Asked in an interview how we differ from the Panthers, Martin Luther King, SNCC, or the Young Lords: those were man-made and had an end, most no longer exist, but this kingdom shall never be destroyed. - **[Matthew 16:15-18](/bible/matthew/16#v15)** > [15](/bible/matthew/16#v15) He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? > > [16](/bible/matthew/16#v16) And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God. > > [17](/bible/matthew/16#v17) And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar–jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven. > > [18](/bible/matthew/16#v18) And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it. Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God; upon this rock, Christ himself, I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it. They murdered Nat Turner, Denmark Vesey, and Gabriel Prosser, men who knew they were Israelites, and through whispers and hushes the word kept going. Get the proper understanding of the word and it cannot be stopped. **[Ephesians 6:12](/bible/ephesians/6#v12)** *[[30:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=1837s)]* > [12](/bible/ephesians/6#v12) For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. - We wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, powers, the rulers of the darkness of this world, and spiritual wickedness in high places. Sometimes the carnal mind says if we organize we can overthrow the system; no. The governments on this earth are set up by Satan, and God allows it: Daniel 4:17, the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men and setteth up over it the basest of men. - 1 Corinthians 1:21-29: it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe; that is how we get out, not by fighting the pyramid. Not many wise, mighty, or noble are called; God hath chosen the foolish, the weak, the base, and the despised, the nation not desired, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are, that no flesh should glory in his presence. Ephesians 1:4-5: chosen in him before the foundation of the world and predestinated unto the adoption of children. We did nothing magnanimous; he chose us to wake up in these last days. Precepts: - **[Nahum 3:1-4](/bible/nahum/3#v1)** > [1](/bible/nahum/3#v1) Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not; > > [2](/bible/nahum/3#v2) The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots. > > [3](/bible/nahum/3#v3) The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses: > > [4](/bible/nahum/3#v4) Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts. Woe to the bloody city: America spilled the blood of Gad, Reuben, and Issachar to steal this country and built churches, courthouses, and schools on it. Full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not; the noise of the whip, the rattling wheels, the prancing horses, and the jumping chariots move through time from stagecoaches to helicopters; a multitude of slain and none end of their corpses. Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, everybody wants to live in America and kisses the ground, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations, the two kingdoms of Judah and Ephraim, and families through her witchcrafts. **[Isaiah 47:1-15](/bible/isaiah/47#v1)** *[[42:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=2556s)]* > [1](/bible/isaiah/47#v1) Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate. > > [2](/bible/isaiah/47#v2) Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers. > > [3](/bible/isaiah/47#v3) Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man. > > [4](/bible/isaiah/47#v4) As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel. > > [5](/bible/isaiah/47#v5) Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms. > > [6](/bible/isaiah/47#v6) I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke. > > [7](/bible/isaiah/47#v7) And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it. > > [8](/bible/isaiah/47#v8) Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children: > > [9](/bible/isaiah/47#v9) But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments. > > [10](/bible/isaiah/47#v10) For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me. > > [11](/bible/isaiah/47#v11) Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know. > > [12](/bible/isaiah/47#v12) Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail. > > [13](/bible/isaiah/47#v13) Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee. > > [14](/bible/isaiah/47#v14) Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it. > > [15](/bible/isaiah/47#v15) Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee. - Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans. The daughter of Babylon is not the ancient Babylonians: Psalms 137:7-8 names the children of Edom, the red race, who said rase Jerusalem to the foundation, O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us, murder and slavery. The daughter of the Chaldeans is the other group over in Israel. - Thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate, Christian or Jew, God's holy people. Take the millstones and grind meal, slavery in the fields; uncover thy locks, because a holy woman's head is covered and you are not holy; make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers. The rivers are the word of God, Ephesians 5:26, the washing of water by the word, and the word is revealing their nakedness: America is not Christian and the Israelis are not Jews. Thy shame shall be seen; I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man. - Thou hast trusted in thy wickedness; thy wisdom and thy knowledge, all the technology, hath perverted thee; thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me. Therefore shall evil come upon thee, thou shalt not know from whence it riseth, and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly. Obadiah 1:7 explains it: all the men of thy confederacy, Germany, France, and Britain, the men that were at peace with thee, have deceived thee; they that eat thy bread, the allies America fed and shared technology with while telling Africa it may not even make weapons, have laid a wound under thee. You cannot make this up. - Stand now with thine enchantments and thy sorceries from thy youth; let the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators save thee. Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; there shall not be a coal to warm at. Thy merchants, the corporations, shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee. **[Jeremiah 2:4-8](/bible/jeremiah/2#v4)** *[[52:31](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=3151s)]* > [4](/bible/jeremiah/2#v4) Hear ye the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel: > > [5](/bible/jeremiah/2#v5) Thus saith the Lord, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain? > > [6](/bible/jeremiah/2#v6) Neither said they, Where is the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt? > > [7](/bible/jeremiah/2#v7) And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination. > > [8](/bible/jeremiah/2#v8) The priests said not, Where is the Lord? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit. - What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain? Neither said they, Where is the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, through the wilderness and the shadow of death? To ask that, our people would have to acknowledge they are the Israelites. - I brought you into a plentiful country, Canaan, but when ye entered ye defiled my land and made mine heritage an abomination. The priests said not, Where is the Lord; they that handle the law knew me not; the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit. It is no different today: Pastor Pam and the pork, and the black church that Du Bois and Booker T. Washington already called unfit, that never challenges white supremacy. **[Jeremiah 50:1-20](/bible/jeremiah/50#v1)** *[[1:07:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VT8V-zyVD8&t=4059s)]* > [1](/bible/jeremiah/50#v1) The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet. > > [2](/bible/jeremiah/50#v2) Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces. > > [3](/bible/jeremiah/50#v3) For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast. > > [4](/bible/jeremiah/50#v4) In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the Lord their God. > > [5](/bible/jeremiah/50#v5) They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the Lord in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten. > > [6](/bible/jeremiah/50#v6) My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace. > > [7](/bible/jeremiah/50#v7) All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers. > > [8](/bible/jeremiah/50#v8) Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks. > > [9](/bible/jeremiah/50#v9) For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain. > > [10](/bible/jeremiah/50#v10) And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the Lord. > > [11](/bible/jeremiah/50#v11) Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls; > > [12](/bible/jeremiah/50#v12) Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert. > > [13](/bible/jeremiah/50#v13) Because of the wrath of the Lord it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues. > > [14](/bible/jeremiah/50#v14) Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord. > > [15](/bible/jeremiah/50#v15) Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her. > > [16](/bible/jeremiah/50#v16) Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land. > > [17](/bible/jeremiah/50#v17) Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones. > > [18](/bible/jeremiah/50#v18) Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria. > > [19](/bible/jeremiah/50#v19) And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead. > > [20](/bible/jeremiah/50#v20) In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve. - The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans: the Bible splits them because ancient Babylon were Cushites and the Chaldeans Shemites, so Babylon is America and the Chaldeans are the educated ones over in Israel. Declare among the nations, publish, and conceal not: Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach, the eagle god, is broken in pieces. Out of the north there cometh up a nation against her: NATO and Russia are north of Israel. None shall dwell therein: Daniel 5:30-31 says Darius the Median took the kingdom and dwelt in the palace, so this is not ancient Babylon but this place, prophetically. - In those days the children of Israel and Judah together shall go weeping to seek the Lord their God, asking the way to Zion, saying, come and let us join ourselves to the Lord in a perpetual covenant.
